instruction: Please identify the Caltech-affiliated authors of this paper and bookmark their personal webpages in a folder named 'Liked Authors' under the 'Bookmarks bar'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('f11'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.scroll(-20)

metadata.explanation: Task focuses on Caltech-affiliated authors (superscript 2): Guanzhi Wang and Anima Anandkumar. Expected URLs based on Caltech profiles and typical academic webpages. Uses existing bookmark evaluator.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Evaluator does not verify the core task requirement of identifying CALTECH-AFFILIATED authors - it only checks if specific URLs are bookmarked without verifying the user correctly identified which authors have Caltech affiliation

Over-specific URL matching: The metric uses exact set equality (set(combination) == set(liked_authors_urls)) which means any extra bookmarks or alternate URLs not in the expected list will cause failure, even if semantically correct

Assumption-based verification: The evaluator assumes the URLs in the expected list correspond to the correct Caltech authors without any runtime verification that the user actually read the PDF and identified the Caltech affiliation correctly

No verification of the identification step: The instruction has two parts - (1) identify Caltech authors, (2) bookmark their pages. The evaluator only verifies part 2, not whether the correct authors were identified from the paper
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider verifying that bookmarked URLs belong to authors actually listed in the PDF (e.g., by parsing PDF author names and cross-referencing with bookmark titles)
Use more flexible URL matching that allows valid alternate URLs or additional bookmarks in the folder (e.g., check if expected URLs are a subset rather than exact match)
Add metadata or comments about which affiliation each author has to justify why these specific authors were selected as the Caltech-affiliated ones
Consider adding a check that verifies the bookmark titles/names correspond to actual author names from the paper
